clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, High Priest Rohan guides the Church of the Holy Light from the Hall of Mysteries. He teaches young priests, helps them deepen their mastery of the Light, and keeps spiritual ties between Ironforge, Stormwind, and distant allies.

High Priest Rohan paces the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward as the Church of the Holy Light’s highest-ranking representative in the city. Dwarves once honored the titans, yet their priests have embraced the Light’s wisdom, compassion, and justice. Rohan patiently teaches young acolytes to channel holy magic and steel their minds against despair.

After priests under his care master the fundamentals, Rohan sends them abroad to learn from other traditions. Human and dwarven students go to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind City. Night elf disciples travel to Priestess Alathea at Darnassus’s Temple of the Moon to study mysteries such as Elune’s Grace. Rohan also sends healers to aid the Cenarion Circle’s druids in distant Azshara, wherever hardship calls.

Rohan keeps sacred relics for the Alliance priesthood and paladin brotherhoods. One is a blessed exorcism censer, used for years to cleanse vile spirits. When the Order of the Silver Hand and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker need it for their knights’ holy calling, Rohan lends it freely. He asks only for charitable alms to replenish Ironforge’s dwindling food reserves for the needy.
